Select: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie (efo_id), indication_label (efo_term), max_phase_for_ind. Source: molecule_dictionary, drug_indication, compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno; molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: max_phase_for_ind = 4; efo_term = 'chronic kidney disease'. Sort: chembl_id ASC, pref_name ASC, canonical_smiles ASC, indication_curie ASC, indication_label ASC, max_phase_for_ind ASC.
